targets.query: from(bucket: "echtzeit") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rtmess") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "jitter_us") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
from(bucket: "echtzeit") |> range(start: -1m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rtmess" and r._field == "temp_c") |> last()
from(bucket: "echtzeit") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rtmess" and r._field == "jitter_us") |> max()
from(bucket: "echtzeit") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rtmess" and r._field == "fehler") |> mean()

from(bucket: "echtzeit") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rtmess") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "druck_hpa" or r._field == "feuchte_pct") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
